title: BigP3BCI Study A — P300 BCI EEG dataset (13 healthy subjects, Mainsah et al. 2025)
description: A derivative P300 brain-computer interface dataset (Study A of the BigP3BCI collection) containing 32-channel EEG recordings from 13 healthy subjects, each with one session, performing a visual speller task with a 6x6 checkerboard stimulus paradigm. Data are sampled at 256 Hz, annotated with HED 8.4.0, and labeled for binary target versus non-target classification. The dataset was processed with the MOABB framework and re-hosted in BIDS format for benchmarking.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) using 32 channels in a standard 10-20 montage at 256 Hz with a 60 Hz line-frequency notch. Participants performed a visual P300 speller task with a 6x6 checkerboard paradigm using row-column and random presentation modes. Epochs spanned 0 to 1.0 s post-stimulus.
